mentions.name: Shellular
mentions.description: This app lets developers use their dev environment from anywhere, providing access to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, etc.), persistent terminals, local repos, and a code editor, plus an in-app browser for remotely accessing localhost ports and a JS console for debugging.

OpenCode, Pi etc.), persistent terminals, local repos and code editor, in-app browser to remotely access localhost:<any-port> and js console for debugging.
